user.title: Connect to Edulog
user.description: Sign in with your Edulog Parent Portal account. Only the access and refresh tokens are saved; your email and password are used for this sign-in only.

data_description.email: The email address you use to sign in to the Edulog Parent Portal.
data_description.password: Your Edulog Parent Portal password. It is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Edulog sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again to replace the expired access token. Your email and password are not saved.

data_description.email: The email address of the Edulog account that was set up.
data_description.password: Your Edulog Parent Portal password. It is not stored.

error.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Edulog account.
